attachments.insertion_landmark: proximal phalanx of the great toe (medial sesamoid)

actions: abducts and flexes the great toe, supports the medial longitudinal arch

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Most medial and superficial of the first (superficial) layer of plantar intrinsic muscles; forms the medial border of the foot, palpable along the medial arch.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
